scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
